summary: Neutralize the CWE-113 HTTP response-splitting flow in the servlet's bad() path. Tainted input from request.getParameter("name") flowed unsanitized into new Cookie("lang", data) and then response.addCookie(...), letting CR/LF in the parameter inject into the Set-Cookie response header. The fix percent-encodes the value with URLEncoder.encode(data, "UTF-8") (the class already imports java.net.URLEncoder) before building the cookie, so CR/LF and other control characters are escaped and can no longer split the header. Ordinary values still encode/decode normally, keeping legitimate functionality and non-constant results; the null check and addCookie call are unchanged, and the enclosing method's "throws Throwable" covers the checked UnsupportedEncodingException.
